s: Today, every farm that supplies goat milk to Meyenberg undergoes an annual audit in order to maintain Certified Humane® status. Certified Humane® is a rigorous animal welfare certification awarded by Humane Farm Animal Care (HFAC), an independent, third-party nonprofit organization based in Virginia. The program is designed to empower consumers to buy food products with the confidence that they came from a farm with high standards for animal welfare.
